title: Methodist brief (SPEC 5.1)
description: What task to give the student now: the rule's recommendation, possibly changed by the client's model (SPEC 5.1, 5.7). The MCP server checks it with jsonschema; catalog ids are checked in code (D42).

rationale.description: Why this task now, in 1-3 sentences. A difficulty outside the corridor must be justified here.

pedagogical_goal.description: reinforce: work on a weak spot; motivate: an easier task to rebuild confidence; new_topic: move to a new topic.

target_concept.description: Topic id from the topic catalog.

difficulty.description: Difficulty 1-5 within the grade level, normally the recommended one from the corridor.

setting.description: Story setting, taken from the student's interests.

traps_to_use.description: Trap ids from the trap catalog for the wrong options.

constraints.description: Extra requirements for the Generator, e.g. question no longer than 3 sentences.

excluded_skills.description: Skill ids copied from the student's profile: the task must not use them.

profile_fields_used.description: Profile fields this choice relied on.
